title: Weston-super-Mare hotel to host after-dark paranormal investigation
excerpt: The Royal Hotel in Weston-super-Mare invites 16 guests to an adults-only paranormal investigation on October 7, exploring rooms, cellars and…
content:
Brave guests are being invited to discover what happens inside a Weston-super-Mare hotel after dark.

The Royal Hotel will allow 16 people to explore parts of its South Parade building during a four-hour paranormal investigation.

Darkened function rooms, vacant bedrooms and cellars will feature in the adults-only experience on Wednesday, October 7.

The Royal Hotel is preparing to open its doors after dark (Image: Newsquest)

"Once our evening draws to a close, your investigation begins," The Royal Hotel said.

"You'll explore darkened function rooms, vacant bedrooms and the cellars beneath the hotel, taking part in paranormal investigations, seances, vigils and experiments along the way."

The event, called The Royal Hotel: After Dark, will run from 10pm until 2am.

The first half of the night will centre on a fictional mystery called The Lost Guest of 1983.

Participants will follow the evidence, uncover the story and decide what they believe happened.

Once the fictional mystery has concluded, the group will investigate the hotel itself.

This section will be guided by real experiences and unexplained incidents reportedly encountered by hotel team members over the years.

The hotel said: "The first half of the night is a mystery.

"The second half is unknown.

"Just the hotel. The dark. And whatever happens when we start asking questions."

Organisers have stressed there will be no actors hiding around corners, staged scares or manufactured paranormal activity.

The hotel has also said it cannot promise that anything paranormal will happen during the investigation.

Tickets have a launch price of £25 per person, with admission restricted to people aged 18 and over.

Advance booking is essential because only 16 places are available.

Full payment must be made when booking, while tickets are non-refundable and non-transferable.

Participants will also need to sign a disclaimer when they arrive.

Bookings can be made by calling 01934 423100 and selecting option one.

The investigation forms part of what The Royal Hotel has described as a "spooky month" of activities during October.
